title: RW-Guard Faculty Review Remediation Requirement Register

requirements.title: Seven-Scheme Watermark Exposure
requirements.faculty_request: Primary model must be trained on all seven distinct watermarking schemes (dct_qim, dwt_qim, ss_spatial, fft_ring, nmp_freq, svd_qim, dct_svd).
requirements.required_remediation: Verify all 7 schemes in code and checkpoint metadata.
requirements.acceptance_test: Strict configuration contains all 7 scheme names and keys in state dict.

requirements.title: Validation-Selected Primary Checkpoint
requirements.faculty_request: Select final primary model using validation performance only (never test data). Freeze checkpoint.
requirements.required_remediation: Verify provenance to validation-selected epoch 14.
requirements.acceptance_test: Exact tensor weight match with runs/seed0/best.pt.

requirements.title: Checkpoint Cryptographic & Architectural Integrity
requirements.faculty_request: Verify SHA-256 hash (37680cdd...) and 2,466,099 trainable parameters of ForensicNet.
requirements.required_remediation: Byte hash calculation and strict architecture validation.
requirements.acceptance_test: SHA-256 bit-identical match, 0 missing/unexpected keys.

requirements.title: Fresh Primary In-Distribution Inference
requirements.faculty_request: Perform fresh model inference from raw test images (disable cached test_preds.npz reuse) on held-out COCO test split.
requirements.required_remediation: Execute fresh forward passes across all 3,000 test samples directly from source images.
requirements.acceptance_test: Predictions generated fresh, matching test labels and AUC within 0.005 tol.

requirements.title: Benign Post-Processing Evaluation
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate primary model across 11 benign operations (JPEG, noise, blur, brightness, compound).
requirements.required_remediation: Verify all 11 condition metrics, operating points, and CIs.
requirements.acceptance_test: All 11 benign transform metrics verified.

requirements.title: Resolution Invariance Evaluation
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate arbitrary resolution invariance across 128px, 256px, and 384px inputs.
requirements.required_remediation: Verify resolution invariance and global adaptive pooling.
requirements.acceptance_test: Metrics verified across 3 resolutions.

requirements.title: PACS Cross-Domain Generalization
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate PACS 4 domains (Photo, Art, Cartoon, Sketch); resolve 1,600 vs 3,200 sample count discrepancy.
requirements.required_remediation: Clarify 1,600 source images vs 3,200 derived samples (2 per source).
requirements.acceptance_test: Discrepancy resolved and domain metrics confirmed.

requirements.title: Adversarial Robustness Evaluation (PGD-10)
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate gradient-based adversarial evasion (PGD-10 at eps=0.5, 1.0, 2.0 / 255); report vulnerability honestly.
requirements.required_remediation: Confirm adversarial evasion results and document vulnerability.
requirements.acceptance_test: Adversarial evasion confirmed without suppression.

requirements.title: Hold-One-Scheme-Out Generalization
requirements.faculty_request: Verify hold-one-scheme-out models are kept distinct from 7-scheme primary model.
requirements.required_remediation: Audit holdout checkpoints as distinct branches.
requirements.acceptance_test: Holdout checkpoints isolated from primary checkpoint.

requirements.title: Independent Multi-Seed Stability
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate 3 independent training runs (Seeds 0, 1, 2) on identical test sources.
requirements.required_remediation: Reconcile seed mean and standard deviation.
requirements.acceptance_test: Mean 0.8528 and std 0.0024 verified.

requirements.title: Distortion-Matched Single Watermark Control
requirements.faculty_request: Generate and evaluate single-watermarked samples matched in distortion (MSE ~9.14) to double-watermarked images.
requirements.required_remediation: Verify per-source distortion matching and evaluation metrics.
requirements.acceptance_test: Distortion match MSE 9.14 confirmed; AUC 0.5747 reproduced.

requirements.title: Nonlinear Residual & Spectral Baselines
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate Logistic Regression and Random Forest on identical held-out test sources; report paired differences.
requirements.original_reported_value: LR AUC 0.5569; RF AUC 0.5500; Paired Delta AUC > +0.29 (p < 0.001)
requirements.required_remediation: Reconcile paired source-level bootstrap comparison on 500 common sources.
requirements.acceptance_test: Paired delta AUC CIs strictly exclude zero (p < 0.001).

requirements.title: Matched-Noise Control Evaluation
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate single-watermarked images + matched Gaussian noise (MSE ~9.13) to isolate structured artifact detection.
requirements.required_remediation: Confirm noise-matched control metrics and CIs.
requirements.acceptance_test: Matched noise AUC 0.7296 reproduced.

requirements.title: Shortcut Learning Scientific Interpretation
requirements.faculty_request: Temper claims: acknowledge perturbation energy accounts for modest detection (0.5747), but structured multi-embedding interference provides dominant signal (0.7296 vs noise, 0.854 vs double).
requirements.required_remediation: Formalize qualified wording in claims audit.
requirements.acceptance_test: Classification: SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION.

requirements.title: TrustMark Zero-Shot Stratified Evaluation
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate zero-shot transfer on TrustMark with stratified negative controls (not easy clean-only).
requirements.required_remediation: Report stratified zero-shot metrics and domain threshold shift.
requirements.acceptance_test: Stratified negative controls verified; AUC 0.6562 reproduced.

requirements.title: TrustMark Supervised Adaptation (15%)
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate supervised adaptation on 15% TrustMark data; clearly distinguish from zero-shot transfer.
requirements.required_remediation: Document fine-tuning protocol and adapted performance.
requirements.acceptance_test: Adapted AUC 0.8505 verified.

requirements.title: Historical TrustMark Protocol Reconciliation
requirements.faculty_request: Reconcile historical values (0.534 4-scheme, 0.696 unstratified, 0.851 adapted, 0.925 earlier adapted).
requirements.required_remediation: Document exact protocol differences across model checkpoints.
requirements.acceptance_test: Historical values reconciled by checkpoint and protocol.

requirements.title: StegaStamp Zero-Shot Forensic Detection
requirements.faculty_request: Evaluate forensic detection on singly vs doubly watermarked StegaStamp images (not just extraction).
requirements.required_remediation: Confirm StegaStamp zero-shot forensic detection metrics.
requirements.acceptance_test: StegaStamp AUC 0.9293 confirmed.

requirements.title: Neural Generalization Claims Rigor
requirements.faculty_request: Acknowledge zero-shot domain gap on TrustMark (0.0% fixed TPR) and report deployment boundaries honestly.
requirements.required_remediation: Formalize domain shift qualification in claims register.
requirements.acceptance_test: Zero-shot domain gap reported without omission.

requirements.title: Watermark Recovery Criteria Definition
requirements.faculty_request: Define explicit bit-accuracy recovery criteria for victim and attacker watermarks.
requirements.required_remediation: Document exact extraction threshold and verification formulas.
requirements.acceptance_test: Bit accuracy formula documented and verified.

requirements.title: Four Mutually Exclusive Attack Outcome Categories
requirements.faculty_request: Classify every attack into: Dual Survival, Successful Overwrite, Failed Attacker Embedding, Both Unrecoverable.
requirements.required_remediation: Audit all 500 attack outcomes for mutual exclusivity and 100% sum.
requirements.acceptance_test: Counts sum to exactly 500; percentages sum to 100.0%.

requirements.title: Dual-Survival Rate Verification (88.7% vs 85.0%)
requirements.faculty_request: Verify actual recovery records: resolve historical 88.7% claim vs actual verified 85.0% (425/500).
requirements.required_remediation: Document exact previous vs current numerator/denominator reconciliation.
requirements.acceptance_test: 425/500 = 85.0% strictly proved; 88.7% reconciled.

requirements.title: Category-Specific Forensic Detection Metrics
requirements.faculty_request: Report category-specific detection rates, detector scores, and ROC-AUC vs common single controls.
requirements.required_remediation: Reconcile category-specific detection metrics.
requirements.acceptance_test: Category metrics verified against common controls.

requirements.title: Ownership Forgery vs Collision Mechanics
requirements.faculty_request: Distinguish between sequential embedding detection, watermark suppression, and legal ownership forgery.
requirements.required_remediation: Clarify that 85% dual survival demonstrates collisions rather than complete erasure.
requirements.acceptance_test: Distinction clearly articulated in claims audit.

requirements.title: 95% Confidence Intervals Across All Metrics
requirements.faculty_request: Provide 95% confidence intervals for ROC-AUC, TPR@1%FPR, fixed-threshold TPR, and fixed-threshold FPR.
requirements.required_remediation: Consolidate across all 34 evaluated experimental conditions.
requirements.acceptance_test: Zero NaN/Inf, lower <= estimate <= upper.

requirements.title: Source-Image Grouped Bootstrap (B >= 2,000)
requirements.faculty_request: Resample source images as independent units (B >= 2,000); do not resample dependent positive/negative pairs independently.
requirements.original_reported_value: B = 2,000 replicates, grouped by source ID
requirements.required_remediation: Document grouped resampling mechanics and diagnostic convergence.
requirements.acceptance_test: B=2000 replicates verified, grouped by source.

requirements.title: Strict Operating Threshold Discipline
requirements.faculty_request: Validation threshold tau = 1.3394 must remain frozen; separate test ROC TPR@1%FPR from fixed-threshold rates.
requirements.required_remediation: Explicitly enforce separation between the two operating point quantities.
requirements.acceptance_test: No recalibration on test set; both metrics reported.

requirements.title: Multi-Seed Standard Deviation Convention
requirements.faculty_request: Resolve population vs sample standard deviation for 3 seeds (sample std = 0.0024 vs pop std = 0.0020).
requirements.required_remediation: Standardize and state sample standard deviation (N-1 degrees of freedom).
requirements.acceptance_test: Exact formula and degrees of freedom documented.

requirements.title: Paired Bootstrap Baseline Difference Testing
requirements.faculty_request: Compare RW-Guard with baselines using paired source-level bootstrap; test delta AUC and low-FPR difference.
requirements.required_remediation: Serialize formal paired comparison statistics.
requirements.acceptance_test: Paired difference CIs exclude zero.

requirements.title: Validation vs Test FPR Discrepancy Investigation
requirements.faculty_request: Investigate shift from 1.00% validation FPR (3/300) to 3.33% test FPR (50/1500); evaluate tail density and KS test.
requirements.original_reported_value: KS test D=0.050, p=0.5485; tail quantization confirmed
requirements.required_remediation: Confirm statistical identity of negative distributions and tail quantization.
requirements.acceptance_test: KS test p=0.55 verified; tail sensitivity explained.

requirements.title: Consolidated Statistical Table
requirements.faculty_request: Produce one authoritative master table covering all conditions, sample counts, metrics, CIs, thresholds, and checkpoints.
requirements.required_remediation: Serialize consolidated statistical CSV and JSON in results/statistics/.
requirements.acceptance_test: All conditions present with complete counts, CIs, and metrics.

requirements.title: Dataset & Source Manifest Reconciliation
requirements.faculty_request: Master source manifest with 5,000 COCO sources; prove zero split leakage.
requirements.required_remediation: Serialize master source manifest CSV and leakage audit.
requirements.acceptance_test: Zero source overlap verified across train, val, and test.

requirements.title: Automated Regression Test Suite
requirements.faculty_request: Execute complete automated unit and integration regression test suite (22 tests); report exact results.
requirements.required_remediation: Execute test suite and serialize machine-readable results.
requirements.acceptance_test: 22/22 tests passing with exit code 0.

requirements.title: Scientific Claim Audit & Reconciliation
requirements.faculty_request: Audit all material claims against raw evidence; classify supported vs qualified claims.
requirements.required_remediation: Serialize before-vs-after claims audit CSV and markdown report.
requirements.acceptance_test: All claims classified with rigorous justification.

requirements.title: Master PowerShell Verification Entry Point
requirements.faculty_request: Create run_rwguard_final_verification.ps1 supporting -Mode Full; execute and verify clean exit.
requirements.missing_evidence: PowerShell wrapper executing all 17 verification stages
requirements.required_remediation: Implement robust run_rwguard_final_verification.ps1 and execute.
requirements.acceptance_test: PowerShell script executes all stages and exits code 0.

requirements.title: Complete Deliverables Archive Packaging
requirements.faculty_request: Assemble complete, portable ZIP package with code, checkpoints, predictions, manifests, tests; verify extraction and SHA-256.
requirements.required_remediation: Build comprehensive package, test extraction, calculate SHA-256.
requirements.acceptance_test: ZIP passes testzip, extracts cleanly, SHA-256 manifest saved.
